key.afkcamera.toggle_screens: Toggle cinematics in menu and chat
afkcamera.configuration.title: AFK Camera settings
afkcamera.configuration.viewpoint.toolti: AUTO mixes character and scenery shots. WORLD_TOUR shows only the surroundings. Other modes keep the selected viewpoint.
afkcamera.configuration.inPauseMenu.tool: Allow camera motion while the Escape menu is open. Single-player worlds stay paused. Menu controls remain usable; closing the menu restores your view.
afkcamera.configuration.inChat.tooltip: Allow camera motion while you type, read or scroll in chat. Black bars are hidden to keep the input clear. Closing chat restores your view.
